title: Falling ill as a small child
text: You fall ill as a small child. The nearest care your household can get without paying is a long way off. In {country} around {year}, about {in100:health_coverage} in 100 people where you live could get essential care without paying.

choices.label: Pay a private clinic nearby
choices.cost: Costs about a month of household income.

choices.label: Travel to the free public clinic
choices.cost: Costs two days of a parent's work and the fare.

choices.label: Care for you at home and wait
choices.cost: No money spent; recovery is slower and less certain.

title: A loss in the family
text: A younger brother or sister dies before turning five. In {country} around {year}, about {per1000:child_mortality} of every 1,000 children did not reach their fifth birthday.
consequence_text: For a year your parents work fewer days. The household's small savings are used up.

title: Leaving school
text: At {age}, the cost of school (fees, uniform, the hours you could be earning) becomes more than your household can carry. You leave school. In {country}, about {in100:school_completion} in 100 young people from households in your income group finish secondary school.

choices.label: Work alongside a relative
choices.cost: Long days; you bring in a small income.

choices.label: Look after younger children so an adult can work
choices.cost: No pay of your own; one more adult earns.

choices.label: Keep studying in the evenings when you can
choices.cost: A small fee and very little rest.

title: Finishing secondary school
text: You finish secondary school. In {country}, about {in100:school_completion} in 100 young people from households in your income group do.

choices.label: Look for work now
choices.cost: Income sooner.

choices.label: Try for further study
choices.cost: Several more years of low or no income.

title: First steady work

variants.text: Your first steady work has no contract: paid in cash, no sick pay, no pension record.
Your first steady work comes with a contract, sick pay and a pension record.

text: {variant} In {country}, about {in100:informality} in 100 workers have no contract.

choices.label: Stay and learn the work
choices.cost: Steady but low pay at first.

choices.label: Keep looking for something else
choices.cost: Some months with little or no pay.

choices.label: Move to a city for work
choices.cost: Higher rent; you leave family support behind.

title: Out of work

variants.text: You receive a small unemployment payment while you look.
There is no payment you qualify for.

text: You lose your work and cannot find more for months. {variant} In {country}, about {in100:youth_unemployment} in 100 young people looking for work cannot find any.

choices.label: Take any short-term work
choices.cost: Unpredictable hours and pay.

choices.label: Ask family for help
choices.cost: Uses up their savings.

choices.label: Spend the time retraining
choices.cost: Months of savings for a course.

title: A health bill
text: Someone in your household needs treatment. The bill is more than a quarter of what the household spends in a whole year. In {country}, about {in100:catastrophic_health_spending} in 100 households in your income group face a bill this size at least once in ten years.

choices.label: Borrow from relatives
choices.cost: A debt to family that takes years to repay.

choices.label: Sell tools, stock or animals
choices.cost: Less to earn with afterwards.

choices.label: Delay the treatment
choices.cost: No money spent now; the illness may get worse.

title: A permit
text: An official says your permit will take months, unless you pay something extra. In {country}, about {in100:bribery_experience} in 100 adults say they have paid a bribe to an official at least once.

choices.label: Pay
choices.cost: About a week's income.

choices.label: Refuse and wait
choices.cost: Months of delay and lost earnings.

choices.label: Ask someone with connections to help
choices.cost: You owe them a favour.

title: A police stop
text: During a police stop near your home you are treated with force and humiliation. No one is charged. In {country}, about {in100:police_mistreatment} in 100 adults say this has happened to them at least once.
consequence_text: You miss two days of work. For months you take a longer route to avoid that street.

choices.label: File a complaint
choices.cost: Hours of your time; experts rate the rule of law here at {score:rule_of_law} out of 1.

choices.label: Tell your family and move on
choices.cost: Nothing more is spent.

choices.label: Ask a community group for help
choices.cost: Time, and your name becomes known to the group.

title: Turned away
text: You are turned away from a job or a flat, and the reason given points to who you are, not to what you can do. In {country}, about {in100:discrimination_experience} in 100 people of your sex say this has happened to them at least once.

choices.label: Apply somewhere else
choices.cost: More weeks of searching.

choices.label: Report it to an authority
choices.cost: Time; the outcome is uncertain.

choices.label: Accept a worse offer from someone who will take you
choices.cost: Lower pay or a worse place to live.

title: Read by someone else
text: You learn that messages you sent were read by someone you never agreed to share them with: an employer, an agency, you are not told which. Experts rate the reach of monitoring in {country} at {score:digital_surveillance} out of 1.

choices.label: Change what you write and to whom
choices.cost: Fewer open conversations.

choices.label: Carry on as before
choices.cost: Nothing changes that you can see.

choices.label: Ask for an explanation
choices.cost: Time; experts rate the rule of law here at {score:rule_of_law} out of 1.

title: A protest in town

variants.text: It has a permit and the route is announced.
It has been declared illegal in advance.

text: People in your town plan a protest about prices and wages. {variant} {country} records about {raw:protest_events} protests per million people a year.

choices.label: Join it
choices.cost: A day's pay, and you are seen there.

choices.label: Stay home
choices.cost: Nothing spent.

choices.label: Help without going (food, passing on news)
choices.cost: A little money and time.

title: The protest is broken up
text: Security forces break up the protest you joined. People are hurt and some are taken away. You get home. In {country}, about {in100:protest_repression_share} in 100 recorded protests are met with force or mass arrests.
consequence_text: Your employer hears that you were there. You lose shifts for the rest of the season.

choices.label: Keep a low profile for a while
choices.cost: You step back from neighbours and groups you trusted.

choices.label: Help the families of those taken away
choices.cost: Money and time; your name is known.

title: Held without charge

variants.text: A lawyer finds you and you are released after a few days.
You are released after several weeks, with no explanation.

text: You are held by the authorities without charge. For the first days your family does not know where you are. {variant} A model estimates about {per100k:arbitrary_detention} in 100,000 people in {country} are held this way each year.
consequence_text: The household loses your income while you are held, and your job is not kept open for you.

choices.label: Look for work again straight away
choices.cost: Some employers will not take you now.

choices.label: Leave the groups and causes you were part of
choices.cost: You lose friendships and a voice you had.

choices.label: Move to another town for a while
choices.cost: Rent elsewhere, far from family.

title: A death in the family
text: Someone in your close family is killed in an act of violence. In {country}, about {per100k:homicide_rate} in 100,000 people are killed this way each year; this simulation assumes a close family of about 15 people.
consequence_text: The household loses an earner and a carer. Plans for the year are put aside.

choices.label: Take on the work they did
choices.cost: Longer days for those left.

choices.label: Move in with relatives
choices.cost: Less space and less say over your own home.

choices.label: Seek help from a support group or the authorities
choices.cost: Time and paperwork.

title: Fighting nearby
text: Fighting reaches your district. Markets and schools close and travel becomes dangerous. In {country}, about {per100k:conflict_deaths} in 100,000 people die in armed conflict each year.
consequence_text: Work stops for weeks. Prices for food and fuel rise.

choices.label: Stay and keep the household going
choices.cost: You live with the danger; you keep your home.

choices.label: Send the children to relatives elsewhere
choices.cost: The family is split up for a time.

choices.label: Leave for a safer town
choices.cost: You leave most of what you own.

title: Forced to leave home
text: Your household is forced to leave its home, and most of what it owned stays behind. A model estimates about {in1000:displacement_risk} in 1,000 people in {country} are forced from their homes each year.
consequence_text: Income falls; children change school; the household's savings are gone.

choices.label: Stay with relatives
choices.cost: Crowded; you depend on their goodwill.

choices.label: Go to a temporary site
choices.cost: Aid, but little privacy and no way to plan.

choices.label: Head for the capital
choices.cost: Work may be easier to find; rent is high.

title: Storm or flood
text: A storm or flood damages your home. A model estimates about {in100:disaster_exposure} in 100 people in {country} have their home damaged this way each year.

choices.label: Rebuild with savings
choices.cost: The savings are gone.

choices.label: Borrow to rebuild
choices.cost: Repayments for years.

choices.label: Patch it up and live with the damage
choices.cost: A colder, wetter home.

title: Someone leaves for abroad
text: A brother, sister or cousin leaves to live and work abroad. In {country}, about {in100:emigration_rate} in 100 households see someone leave in a given year.

choices.label: Rely on the money they send home
choices.cost: The household depends on one person far away.

choices.label: Take over what they did at home
choices.cost: More work for you.

choices.label: Start planning to follow them
choices.cost: Savings put aside for the journey.
